itens.titulo: O balanço da Vale foi bom ou ruim? Ação sobe mesmo com queda no lucro do 3º tri
itens.descricao: O balanço da Vale foi bom ou ruim? Ação sobe mesmo com queda no lucro do 3º tri Exame
trechos: Vale: ação de maior peso do Ibovespa sobe após balanço do 3º tri (Photo Illustration by Piotr Swat/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images) Publicado em 30 de outubro de 2026 às 14h30.
Última atualização em 30 de outubro de 2026 às 14h38.
A Vale (VALE3) sobe na B3 nesta sexta-feira, 30, em mais um pregão negativo para o Ibovespa, que caminha para a quinta sessão seguida de queda.
A alta vem um dia depois de a mineradora informar que lucrou US$ 1,26 bilhão no terceiro trimestre, 53% menos do que um ano antes.
Por volta das 14h30 (horário de Brasília), os papéis VALE3 subiam 3,2%, a R$ 61,97, chegando a R$ 62,98 na máxima do dia.
O BTG Pactual resumiu o resultado como "um trimestre fraco no geral", que atendeu às expectativas baixas do banco e do consenso.
Ficou 15,5% acima do que o Itaú BBA esperava, de US$ 1,09 bilhão, e 22% abaixo da conta da XP, de US$ 1,60 bilhão.
Ajustes na provisão para a Samarco e efeitos de câmbio sobre impostos tiraram centenas de milhões de dólares do resultado.

itens.titulo: Wall Street analysts like Amazon's AWS outlook
itens.descricao: Wall Street analysts like Amazon's AWS outlook Yahoo Finance
trechos: Amazon (AMZN) reported mixed results after the bell on Thursday, missing Wall Street's targets on earnings per share and revenue, but posting better-than-anticipated Q3 AWS revenue.
Amazon stock fell more than 7% in premarket action Friday, but pared much of those losses as the trading day went on.
For the quarter, Amazon saw earnings per share (EPS) of $1.89 on revenue of $201.9 billion.
Analysts projected EPS of $1.97 on revenue of $202.25 billion, according to Bloomberg's analyst consensus estimates.
The company reported EPS of $1.95 and revenue of $180.16 billion in the same period last year.
The biggest number from the company's report was its AWS revenue, which increased 39% year over year to $46.0 billion.
It's the second consecutive quarter the segment has grown more than 30%, and CEO Andy Jassy says the company anticipates more than 40% growth in the business in 2027 and 2028.
And though he maintained the firm's Buy rating on the stock, he lowered his price target to $317 from $320.

itens.descricao: Why Intel Is Down Today Yahoo Finance
trechos: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) stock is sinking, down 5.5% to $897 as of 112:45 p.m.
30, following Intel's less-than-stellar earnings forecast and slipping PC sales.
The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite are down 1.5% and 2.6%, respectively.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
CFO David Zinsner warned the slowdown would run at least through the first half of 2027.
It's now projecting Q4 revenue to come in at $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion -- Wall Street wanted $17.1 billion.
The company forecast a gross margin of 38%, down from the 44.1% in Q3.
